title: Passing Along God's Wisdom
excerpt: Proverbs 22:6 reminds us that our faithfulness shapes others. Why passing along God's wisdom takes time, care, and trust in Him.

blocks.text: What if the choices you make today could shape someone else's life for years to come?
Proverbs 22:6 says, "Direct your children onto the right path, and when they are older, they will not leave it."
It reminds us that our actions don't just affect us—they also act as an example, guiding and directing others, whether we realize it or not. And which direction we guide others… matters.
When you trust Him, God can use your consistent acts of faithfulness over time to plant His wisdom deep in a person's heart.

The book of Proverbs is a powerful collection of wisdom meant to teach people how to live well and thrive according to God's values. Throughout Proverbs, parents are encouraged to pass that wisdom on to their children. It's one of the clearest examples of the Bible telling us exactly what Scripture is for. The goal is not simply to pass on rules to follow, but to train others to see clearly so they can recognize the difference between the path of wisdom and the path of foolishness.
Proverbs 22:6 isn't saying that parents can control the choices their children make. Instead, it points to the lasting influence of faithful, consistent guidance.

This kind of influence takes time and genuine care. It happens through repeated conversations, everyday choices, Scripture, prayer, correction, encouragement, and setting an example. If you're not sure where to start, consider inviting a child, friend, or family member to begin a simple practice with you: reading one chapter of the book of Proverbs each day. It is full of God's powerful wisdom for a thriving life.

Whether you're guiding a child, mentoring someone younger, or simply trying to live faithfully before others, remember this: you may not see the results of your faithfulness today. That doesn't mean you aren't making an impact. Keep going. Trust God with what you cannot see. Trust that when you plant God's wisdom, over time, it will take root and grow.

God, today I lift up the future generation. Empower and encourage them to live and love like You. Prepare me to be a godly example for the young people in my own life. Move in this generation's hearts like never before. Give them a hunger for Your truth. In Jesus' name, Amen.
